setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Frozen Logger**: rare: 9 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.92840.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 143 min; rated 4.25/5 by 20 [1]
- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.bertha.94218.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 143 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader says the restoration aims to approximate how the original reels sounded when recorded [2]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.8474.unknown.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 71 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording good but average 1972 material, and notes it covers only the first set; Reviewer finds the sound good, but marks it down because only part of the show circulates [6][11]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.partial.deibert.12751.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 46 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the single surviving reel as excellent sounding, with strong playing and singing [13]

## Around the show

- Attendee of all four nights says the first set suffered many stage technical problems, with Jerry talking to the crowd and joking about Bobby's lunch [9]
- Attendee says no full setlist was ever recorded, only one reel survives, and believes the New Riders did not play [13]
- Reviewer notes the vault reportedly holds only a partial reel covering half of the first set [16]
- Second-set tape runs out at the end of The Other One, as Bobby starts a Weather Report Suite Prelude [1]
- Attendee rates this the best of the four nights, ahead of the much-praised 8-27-72 show, and a personal peak until 1977 [9]
- Reviewer, who attended, prefers this show to the 8-27 Veneta show and calls it the best of 1972 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.92840.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Transfer made from DATs lent by Rob Eaton [1]
- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.bertha.94218.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>FLAC>>DAW(Bertha)>>Audio DVD>>FLAC [2]. Also: Digitally remastered on the Bertha Digital Audio Workstation, completed August 4, 2008 [2]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.8474.unknown.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Partial first set from soundboard through MR and PCM to DAT; partial second set from an FM soundboard, source unknown [3]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.partial.deibert.12751.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: First set partial from a 7-inch Betty Board reel via PCM501ES and Fostex D5 (Jace's tape), then to disk by Tim Deibert; Tim Deibert did some Soundforge editing on the transfer [4]
